PETOPIA · P1C My Pet · for your review

Foxy Animation Review

Codex redrew all four animations on one sheet, copied from our in-game pixel Foxy, so every set shares the same look: the same pixel style, black legs, round eyes, no eyebrows. None of these are in the game yet. Frames are cut at the real gaps between drawings and share one size and one ground line.

Eat

Eat: head in the bowl, chew, lick, happy heart.

Bathe

Bath: in the tub with bubbles, bubbles on the head, wet, shake dry.

Sleep

Sleep: lie down, curl up with the tail, breathe, wake and stretch.

Carry

Fetch: run back with the ball in the mouth (two strides), drop it, sit proudly.

Next to the child, at game size

From left: the child (42 px in the world), today's in-game Foxy at the child stage (22 px), then the candidates at that same Foxy size: eat, fetch with the ball in the mouth, bath shake, sleep. Same Foxy, same size, same style as in the adventure.
